result:
QA-20319 is a PASS, and the report is written to `results/2026-10-23/QA-20319-report.md`. I ran both Friday rows: Hulu / Hulu and Ralph Lauren / Ralph Lauren. Each ran on the Video Views data set, Jan 01 – Dec 31, 2024, Facebook only. The case file lists no open linked bugs, and no bugs were filed.

| Leg | Posts evaluated | Sum of views = Video Views | Engagements / Video Views = Video Response Rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hulu | 200 of 820 | 200/200 match; aggregate row also matches | 200/200 match |
| Ralph Lauren | 57 of 57 | 57/57 match; aggregate row also matches | 57/57 match |

- **Aggregate rate not comparable:** the Sum/Average row shows "N/A" for Video Response Rate in both legs, so the rate check rests on the per-post values.
- **Hulu coverage:** Table View renders only the top 200 of the 820 Hulu posts, so the other 620 weren't checked individually. The aggregate row, which covers all 820, does satisfy the sum identity.
- **Alternate-day note:** I didn't apply the "Amazon Prime Video on alternative days" line and used the Friday row as written.

I skipped skill and registry updates, as instructed. The report notes two new mechanics for the harvest step: how to open the user menu for account switching, and that the date-picker selectors from the 2026-10-20 run still work.
